Name: Seb spicy character
Author: yunni234
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3]This mod redraws Sebastian's character walking sprites. It includes sprites for beach, winter, Flower Dance and wedding scenes, with an extra bonus vampire Sebastian sprite.[/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]本模组为重绘塞巴斯蒂安 Sebastian 的角色行走图 包含沙滩 冬季 花舞节 婚礼场景造型 额外吸血鬼Seb补图[/color]

This mod is incompatible with other mods that replace Sebastian's walking sprites.
本模组与其他Sebastian行走图美化模组不兼容

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Install SMAPI framework in advance.
2. Unzip the mod folder and place it into your  Stardew Valley/Mods  folder.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI to activate the mod.
4. Drag the bonus vampire Sebastian sprite into  Vampire Sebastian/assets/Sprite , rename it to overwrite one walking sprite to use it.[/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]1 提前安装好SMAPI框架
2 将解压后的模组文件夹放入 Stardew Valley/Mods 文件夹内
3 通过SMAPI启动游戏即可生效[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]4 把文件夹中的吸血鬼seb补图拖入Vampire Sebastian/assets/Sprite 中修改名称覆盖其中一个行走图就可以使用了[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]SMAPI and Content Patcher are required.[/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]需要安装 SMAPI 与 Content Patcher[/color]
